verdict.label: Prices falling
verdict.headline: Card prices are falling: hold your coins and buy only cards you will play.
verdict.detail: Ezzcoins' Top 100 index is 112.2 (-0.2% in a day) and momentum is 40: prices are falling. 84s cost 800, 85s 2,500 and 86s 5,000. Midweek is usually the quietest time to buy cards for the weekend.

index.note: Ezzcoins' own index from live console prices, read at {{t:2026-11-04T22:36:00+00:00}}.

moves.title: Sell Erëleta Memeti 84 Team of the week after its 13% fall, expect it lower in two days
moves.detail: Tracked call: in at 14,500 coins. Now 12,250. Sell the slide: a playable card that fell sharply in a day often keeps falling for another two days. Picked because it is down 13.4% in about a day. Two price readings about an hour apart agree on this price. This strategy is 4 of 7 so far, averaging +7.9% after tax. A sell call is a hit if the price is lower at check time.

moves.title: Sell Marcus Rashford 82 after its 23% fall, expect it lower in two days
moves.detail: Tracked call: in at 11,750 coins. Now 11,750. Sell the slide: a playable card that fell sharply in a day often keeps falling for another two days. Picked because it is down 23.0% in about a day. Two price readings about an hour apart agree on this price. This strategy is 3 of 6 so far, averaging +2.7% after tax. A sell call is a hit if the price is lower at check time.

moves.title: Quiet midweek: plan your weekend squad now
moves.detail: Midweek is usually the cheapest time to buy cards you will play at the weekend. The next Rivals rewards come {{t:2026-11-05T07:59:00+00:00}} and add fodder supply.

moves.title: Fodder: 84s are the best value per point, 88s the dearest
moves.detail: Cheapest prices: 84s 800 (0.96 coins per Item Score point), 85s 2,500 (1.19 coins per Item Score point), 86s 5,000 (1.22 coins per Item Score point), 87s 7,000 (1.27 coins per Item Score point), 88s 12,750 (1.54 coins per Item Score point). For SBCs that ask for an Item Score, 84s then 85s fill it cheapest. Use fodder in SBCs rather than trading it: selling costs the 5% tax.

moves.title: Miroslav Stevanović and other falling cards: wait for the fall to flatten
moves.detail: Biggest falls in the last day: Miroslav Stevanović 75 Rare -70.9%; Alexandros Kyziridis 75 Rare -67.9%; Dominik Kotarski 75 Rare -65.6%; Nicolas Jackson 79 Rare -64.3%. Buy only cards you will play, and wait for two steady updates before buying.
